svg.aria-label: トラップ Terra 5.6 reversible sound form
svg.data-visual-thesis: ハイハットの細かい刻みを片側から跳ねる三角の列にし、808の落下と鋭い間隔を正面化する。
svg.data-composition-rule: 主構造は片側へ流れるハット扇と低い808ポケット、余白は扇の外に残し、Protected PCMはtriangle-fanで斜めに流す。
svg.title: トラップ Illustrator handoff / production PCM injection ready
svg.desc: トラップ Illustrator artwork handoff. This lightweight file intentionally contains no PCM particles. The production export injects pcm_reversible_data from the actual audio after the artwork is returned.

Terra 5.6 reconstructs the reversible sound form as a white-print composition: a genre-specific primary structure and engine-specific grain aligned with the protected PCM shape. PCM restoration data is added as visible locked pcm_reversible_data geometry on export.

g.data-logo-reading: 刻む・落とす・空ける
